title: News Coverage of Specialized Topics; From Field to Feed: News Video for Social Media
description:
Prerequisite: JOUR620.

In this course, you will learn the principles, strategies, and techniques behind high-performing news videos on social media platforms, such as YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok. We will delve into the multifaceted aspects of social videos in journalism through theoretical frameworks, multimodal analysis, real-world case studies, and hands-on projects. All you need to bring is a smartphone, and your sharp mind!
